title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten verified no-cost ways to explore art, nature, science, campus life, and Beach athletics with friends at or around CSULB.

cards.entity_name: Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.title: Browse the Kleefeld Museum Galleries
cards.subtitle: Free contemporary-art outing on campus
cards.notes: Meet in Glenn Court, explore the current galleries together, and check the museum’s visitor page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A purchase-free museum meetup centered on rotating and ongoing contemporary-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official exhibitions page states that admission is free to all visitors and lists current and ongoing exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions | Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Free to all visitors; confirm current museum hours and closures on the official visitor page.

cards.title: Walk the Campus Art Park
cards.subtitle: An outdoor art loop across CSULB
cards.notes: Open the museum’s Art Park guide, choose several campus works, and turn the route into a relaxed group photo walk.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced outdoor circuit through named artworks installed around the university grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists Art Park as an ongoing exhibition at various CSULB campus locations, while its official exhibitions page states museum admission is free to all visitors.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions | Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus activity; use the official Art Park information and observe any posted campus access restrictions.

cards.title: Compare Picks from the Permanent Collection
cards.subtitle: A free small-group gallery conversation
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the Archives Room, each select one work, then compare details and interpretations before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A focused art hang built around selections from the museum’s permanent holdings.
cards.evidence_claim: The official exhibitions page identifies Selections from the Permanent Collection as an ongoing Archives Room exhibition and states that museum admission is free to all visitors.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions | Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Free to all visitors during museum access hours; verify that the Archives Room is open before visiting.

cards.title: Take a Garden Stroll
cards.subtitle: Reservation-based calm for the CSULB community
cards.notes: Reserve before arriving, meet beside the entrance, and follow the paths and bridges without adding koi food or purchases.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, no-purchase walk among the garden’s pond, plants, bridges, and architectural features.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB states that the garden is open to the public and free for CSULB students, faculty, and staff, with reservations required.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Free for CSULB students, faculty, and staff; an advance reservation is required. Public admission terms may differ.

cards.entity_name: Earl Burns Miller Japanese Garden Bloomberg Connects Guide
cards.title: Share the Garden Audio Tour
cards.subtitle: Free on-site or remote garden exploration
cards.notes: Download the free guide, choose audio or visual mode, and explore together in the garden or from a campus lounge.
cards.short_summary: A guided garden session that works either on location or remotely with no app purchase required.
cards.evidence_claim: The garden’s official page says Bloomberg Connects is offered free and provides a free personalized tour usable on-site or offsite.
cards.source_title: Tour the EBM Japanese Garden with the Bloomberg Connects App
cards.access_notes: The digital guide is free and works offsite; an in-person garden visit remains subject to reservations and eligibility rules.

cards.title: Gallery-Hop Through Student Work
cards.subtitle: Five galleries with free admission
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, invite classmates, and move through the five gallery spaces while discussing one work each.
cards.short_summary: A rotating student-art meetup spanning several dedicated exhibition rooms on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB describes a five-gallery exhibition space showcasing student work and explicitly lists free admission for Student Art Galleries exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Art & Design Events 2 | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Free admission; exhibitions operate on academic schedules, so confirm the current show and gallery hours first.

cards.title: Tour the Shark Lab Together
cards.subtitle: Free public science day on campus
cards.notes: Arrive for the public event, tour the Marine Lab facilities, and leave extra time for the scheduled science activities.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly science hang featuring Shark Lab facilities and marine-learning experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 2026 event page schedules Sharks @ The Beach for July 25, 2026, and states that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Sharks @ The Beach | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event was free and open to the public; campus parking required payment, so arrive without parking on campus to keep the outing free.

cards.title: Meet Future Classmates at Day at The Beach
cards.subtitle: Free open house for Fall 2026 admits
cards.notes: RSVP as an eligible admitted student, coordinate a meeting point, and explore tours, showcases, and resource tables together.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission-cost campus day for incoming students and their families to make early connections.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB’s official page identifies Day at The Beach as a free campus-wide event for Fall 2026 newly admitted students and their families.
cards.source_title: Day at The Beach | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Free but limited to Fall 2026 newly admitted students and their families; RSVP and event-date requirements apply.

cards.title: Ride the East Loop with Friends
cards.subtitle: A free campus-community circuit
cards.notes: Show your campus ID, board together at a marked stop, and use the loop to scout a future study or meetup location.
cards.short_summary: A fare-free campus circuit that doubles as an easy orientation ride for Beach community members.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB states that campus shuttles are a free service for all students, staff, and faculty and lists the East Loop as an on-campus route.
cards.source_title: Shuttle | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Free for students, staff, and faculty with campus ID; service resumes August 24, 2026, and does not run during breaks or holidays.

cards.title: Cheer at a Beach Home Game
cards.subtitle: Student-ID admission at no added cost
cards.notes: Pick a home event, verify its student-ticket instructions, bring your CSULB ID, and meet your group before entry.
cards.short_summary: A school-spirit meetup at an eligible Beach Athletics contest with student admission covered.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB’s current Campus Life page states that tickets to campus athletics games are free for students.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Free for CSULB students; confirm the specific game’s student-entry procedure and bring a valid campus ID.
